sections.h2: India's refined-fuel surplus fell from US$52,879 million to US$43,653 million

chart.title: Diesel, jet fuel and fuel oil earned nearly twice the petrol group's exports
chart.sub: Refined-petroleum export values, FY2025-26, US$ million.

sections.means: The surplus shrank by a sixth in a year, and because TRADESTAT gave no quantities, much of that fall is likely price rather than volume.
sections.todo: Treat the surplus as a value figure and check barrel volumes before planning around a growing pile of fuel to sell.

sections.h2: The Netherlands took 15.9% of refined-fuel exports, ahead of the UAE and Singapore

chart.title: The Netherlands is the largest buyer, and the neighbourhood sits well down the list
chart.sub: Refined-petroleum export values by destination, FY2025-26, US$ million.

sections.means: Most of India's refined fuel is sold into distant markets, with the Netherlands alone taking US$8,435 million.
sections.todo: Watch the Netherlands and Gulf buyers first, since they carry most of the surplus.

sections.h2: Nepal, Sri Lanka and Bhutan already take 5.2% of exports, and Sri Lanka is growing

chart.title: Sri Lanka's purchases rose 30.3% while Nepal's fell 5.3%
chart.sub: Indian refined-petroleum exports to neighbours, FY2025-26, US$ million.
chart.source: DGCI&S TRADESTAT, HS 2710, FY2024-25 and FY2025-26.

sections.means: Nepal and Bhutan are already supplied through Indian public-sector subsidiaries, so only Sri Lanka offers real room to grow.
sections.todo: Compete on price for Sri Lanka's trade rather than assuming a captive neighbourhood market will expand.

sections.h2: India imports far more ethyl alcohol than it exports, a net deficit of US$352.9 million

chart.title: Imports of US$407.2 million outweigh exports of US$54.3 million
chart.sub: Ethyl alcohol trade, FY2025-26, US$ million; HS 2207, all grades.

sections.means: Customs data show India as a buyer of alcohol, so idle distillery capacity is unused plant rather than exportable stock.
sections.todo: Do not build an export plan on ethanol until the trade balance, not installed capacity, turns positive.
